notes.title: Huge Update: Zombies, Action Roguelite, & More!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We’ve just dropped our biggest update yet for Rebloom, and it changes everything:
What’s New
New Genre Twist - Rebloom now plays as an action roguelite! Fast-paced survival and progression.

Multiple Islands - Smaller areas with a time limit.

Zombies & Bosses - Face off against hordes of infected zombies and bosses guarding each island.

Infection Levels - Increase the difficulty for no extra reward.
Jump In & Tell Us What You Think
This update is still in demo form - your feedback will directly shape how these new systems evolve before full release.

Play the updated demo now: Rebloom on Steam
Share your feedback here: Community Hub



Thanks for playing :)
